body:
feed, soap, and a clean jar, paid cash. my note below says violet powder came from the well-water study; the mice abandoned the bin before the nurse stopped taking calls.

Nobody agreed on whose list this belonged to. I left it where the next person would look for the things we still owed each other.

I thought someone would ask for this at the gate. They asked instead how many were in the car, and let the paper stay in my hand.
title: weathered bundle note — after monday supper

body: A handwritten note beside the coolers says the coastal road was open through sundown. Someone came back for a forgotten shoe after dark and found the gate shut. The person responsible for the sign had gone home with the only key.
title: The last shore road
